actions.visual_cue: clean hands with no soap or foam on them held under the running water, before any soap
one hand presses the soap dispenser or takes the soap bar; a blob of soap or fresh lather sits in one palm
both palms pressed flat against each other, rubbing back and forth or in circles, lather building up; it can happen under or away from the running water
the palm or fingers of one hand slide over the BACK of the other hand (its knuckles and back face the camera), then the hands swap; under or away from the water
hands held still or turned under the stream while the foam is visibly washing off, after the rubbing is done; little or no rubbing
hands rub or pat a paper towel, away from the faucet handle

actions.label_es: tocar la llave con la mano
actions.visual_cue: a bare hand, with no paper towel in it, grips or pushes the faucet handle

actions.label_es: cerrar la llave con la toalla
actions.visual_cue: a hand holding a paper towel grips the faucet handle to turn the water off
